info.title: Mandate Hackathon API
info.description: Contract-first prototype: one trusted FastAPI transaction service, scoped agent access, independently retained audit checkpoints and a bounded verification component. HKD only. All payments simulated. See README.md for normative transaction, delegation and evidence requirements.

servers.description: Local API; expose only scoped ingress when needed.

post.summary: Check policy and atomically reserve every applicable budget
post.description: A well-formed request is HTTP 200 whether approved, refused or requiring review. Atomically reserve all ancestor and child budget periods. Refusal reserves nothing. No approval token in refusal.
